conclusion: Do not treat the generic R595.91.07 supported-products list as proof that Ubuntu nvidia-driver-595-server-open supports PC3 RTX 5080. The staged package set is version-matched and signed-metadata-bearing, but its exact flavor/product support and boot/runtime behavior on PC3 are unverified. It is not a qualified rollback path.
